title: Diving Helmet
description: This project adds a simple diving helmet to your minecraft world.
body:
This project adds a simple diving helmet to your minecraft world.

The crafted helmet includes the following enchantments:
- Aqua Afinity
- Respiration (infinite)

In order to craft, add the following items in a crafting table.

No specific order or layout is needed:
- Iron Helmet
- Pufferfish
- Glass
